claims.statement: For the retained exact-source operation timings, three jobs have a kernel-composed upper bound below 90 ms; each job is prepare, both independent branches, then publish, and no aggregate stopwatch is used.

Under the declared per-invocation engineering error envelopes for validation and checksum, the union-bound probability that all branches succeed for three jobs is at least 0.91; no independence assumption is made.
assumptions: Each validation invocation has bad-event probability at most 0.01.
Each checksum invocation has bad-event probability at most 0.02.

claims.statement: The declared five slots are conserved across every task-start transition and every typed completion outcome.
Conditional on the declared service and dispatch envelopes, ready-or-running inventory remains positive before each of five publication completions and ready work is dispatched within 5 ms.
assumptions: timing:prepare/service-envelope is an assumed duration upper bound of 10 ms.
timing:publish/service-envelope is an assumed duration range of 8 ms through 20 ms.
timing:publish/dispatch is an assumed wait upper bound of 5 ms.
Producer workers remain work-conserving during the five-publication finite horizon.

metadata.purpose: Plain-English claims for the generic structured worker-pipeline example
